title: The independent scalar unit/Chern splitting isomorphisms
statement: Let l,p be distinct primes, k of characteristic p, Y a finite-type quasi-compact separated k-scheme with Y,P=P1_Y,W=P×Y P Noetherian and DiagonalTraceLocalizations. Give delta, Family and Reference r as in [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Let a and b be completed positive Chern adjuncts of r.tq and r.t2 satisfying their whole-system CompletedChernNormalized equations [def-sfb-rational-p1-scalar-chern-maps]. At any finite rational or closure coefficient c, let uq,u2 be the actual twisted-unit adjuncts and cq,c2 their independently transported Chern adjuncts. Then both biprod.desc(uq,cq) and biprod.desc(u2,c2) are isomorphisms. This statement contains neither geometric exchange nor any trace equation.

source.place: Second identity, scalar trace base change before tensoring with q*K.

proof.text: Use the scalar Q splitting theorem for the first conjunct.
Use the scalar second-projection splitting theorem for the second conjunct.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_chern_splittings
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (c : Option (PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP k p] (hpl : p ≠ l)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (r : Reference l Y δ family)
    (a : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l Y ⟶
      r.tq.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l r.tq.toPresentation a)
    (b : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l (ProjectiveLine Y) ⟶
      r.t₂.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l (diagonalSurface Y)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hb : CompletedChernNormalized l r.t₂.toPresentation b) :
    let Λ := (coefficient l c).X
    let L := line l c
    let T := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ X) 0).obj (L X)) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let uq := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (T Y) (T (ProjectiveLine Y))
      (scalarQLineIso l c k p hpl Y)
    let u₂ := scalarTwistedUnit Λ (secondProjection Y)
      (T (ProjectiveLine Y)) (T (diagonalSurface Y)) (secondLineComparison l c k p hpl Y)
    let cq := scalarQChern l c Y r a
    let c₂ := scalarP2Chern l c Y r b
    IsIso (biprod.desc uq cq) ∧ IsIso (biprod.desc u₂ c₂)
